original_question: Write a Verilog module named `karnaugh_map`. The module should have a 4-bit input `x` (where x[3] is the MSB) and a single output `f`. The output `f` should be high (logic 1) when the decimal value represented by the input `x` (with x[3] as the most significant bit) is one of the following: 3, 5, 7, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, or 15. Implement the logic using a simplified sum-of-products expression derived from these minterms, using basic gate operations.
